checks.evidence: Subject: two copies ... Left copy (state A) ... Right copy (state B) ...
story props carry content; only targeted negatives
text block has quotes, surface, position, occlusion
Setting: plain backdrop only; no frames, screens or signs
'each about 46% of the frame width' x2 = 92% plus 'both copies fully inside the frame with a 4% margin' (8%) leaves no gap between copies
Continuity line present; first use of the sheet
square 1:1; type sheet, openai/gpt-image-2/text-to-image medium at 1024x1024, no references, one image
'straight-on' with 'soft contact shadows' does not say whether the organizers hang upright or lie flat
FL-04 content given, FL-01 no hands near text, FL-11 one woman per view

corrected_prompt:
Format: Handmade claymation stop-motion look: plasticine characters with visible thumbprints and slight tool marks, soft rounded forms, miniature handmade set pieces, warm practical lighting, shallow depth of field like a tabletop set, gentle stop-motion texture. Stop-motion clay puppet detail: tiny real craft materials on the clay, thread-wrapped hair, real fabric and felt, real stitching. Palette: warm ivory and marble, charcoal accents. A prop reference sheet, square 1:1, on a plain soft warm-ivory paper backdrop with even studio light.

Reference images: none attached.

Subject: two copies of the same organizer side by side at the same scale, each hanging upright and flat against the backdrop and facing the camera straight-on, each about 43% of the frame width with a 6% gap between them. Each copy is a felt wall organizer about 60 cm wide: ivory felt with charcoal stitching, a header band at the top with the word "CLIENTS" stitched in big charcoal capitals, two rows of four open-topped pockets, a thick label band at the left end of each row with "MARCH" on the upper row and "APRIL" on the lower row in big charcoal capitals. Left copy (state A): each MARCH pocket holds three small clay client figures shown from the chest up above the pocket rim, smiling softly, in blazers of different colours (12 in all); all four APRIL pockets are empty. Right copy (state B): the MARCH row identical to the left copy (12 clients); in the APRIL row exactly one small clay client in each pocket (4 in all), and a plain sand-cream linen band stitched along the top edge of the APRIL row.

Hands: no hands in the frame.

Action: none, a still sheet.

Props: only the two organizers and the small clay clients inside their pockets.

Text: on each copy exactly three strings in charcoal capitals: "CLIENTS" on the header band, top centre; "MARCH" on the upper row's label band at its left end; "APRIL" on the lower row's label band at its left end. Nothing covers any letter. The linen band carries no words. No other lettering.

Setting: the plain warm-ivory backdrop only, soft contact shadows.

Camera: straight-on, both copies fully inside the frame with a 4% margin, square 1:1.

Continuity: this is the locked design of the organizer in every shot: same felt, stitching, labels and pocket layout.

Negatives: no fabric scraps on either copy; never more than one client in an APRIL pocket on the right copy; no logos. Everything in frame is real modeling clay, felt and fabric, photographed: visible fingerprints and tool marks, real cast shadows, soft studio lighting.
note: Note: the spec itself fails G-SPEC (no close-up crops, label legibility at 360 px); this correction keeps the current layout.
